title: Molecular/genomic CDEs for EWSR1 fusions/variants (HGVS/HGNC/SO/GA4GH VRS; schema only, no sequence data)
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Elyos never holds patient data. Molecular CDEs represent EWSR1 fusions/variants via open standards (HGVS/HGNC/SO/GA4GH VRS) as schema only, with no sequence or biospecimen data (depends on cde-020). Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Define molecular/genomic CDEs for EWSR1 fusions and variants using open representation standards, schema only.
acceptanceCriteria: EWSR1-FLI1/EWSR1-ERG and variant representation via open standards
